title: Missing Security Headers
summary: Six standard security headers are absent, weakening protection against XSS, clickjacking, and downgrade attacks.
problem: Six standard security headers are absent, weakening protection against XSS, clickjacking, and downgrade attacks.
recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

problem: The homepage offers only one CTA that exits to an external domain, creating a shallow funnel with no internal next step.
recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Primary: [Benefit-oriented CTA] Secondary: Learn more; notes: Add an internal conversion-oriented CTA (e.g., Sign up, Request demo) and keep Learn more as secondary.
evidence: The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”. | [Learn more](https://iana.org/domains/example)
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
